prompts.people: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production website circular illustrated icon, PEOPLE, in a coordinated six-medallion set for CyberAlchemy Lab. Create ONE isolated circular glass medallion, perfectly front facing, centered on genuinely transparent background. Editorial, sophisticated, slightly tactile museum-object aesthetic rather than stock vector icon. Within a clear warm ivory translucent glass disc with a delicate graphite rim, depict TWO simple sculptural human bust silhouettes side by side, facing slightly inward, as collaborators. Bold simplified silhouettes, generous negative space, subtle etched graphite lines, restrained graphite/ink accent, slight material depth and soft internal refraction. The subject must be instantly recognizable at 72px and fill the inner 70 percent of the circle. Warm cream/ink palette matching an institutional research website with a large transparent orb. Light from upper left, crisp silhouette, minimal fine detail, consistent full-circle framing. Outside circle fully transparent; no square backdrop, no cast shadow outside disc, no lettering, no numbers, no labels, no watermark, no glow, no neon, no gradients into a rectangular background. Square image with circle centered, 8 percent margin around circle. Do not render a UI or multiple icons.
